source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, General Information and Lubrication, p.0-8

procedures.title: Vehicle lifting points: Corvette (figures 9 and 10)
notes: Figure 9 in the manual: drive-on hoist or two-post hoist with drive-on adapters contacts the tires; floor jack, jack stands or center-post hoist go on the frame side rails at four places (behind the front kick-up and ahead of the rear kick-up on each side); jack stands may also go under the front frame horns at the very front.
Figure 10 in the manual: frame lift adapter (steel beam with wood blocks) under the rear of the frame, clearing the exhaust pipes.
